description: A single-owner 530i M Sport in Mineral White that still feels showroom-fresh. The 2.0-litre turbo delivers effortless overtakes yet settles into a calm, refined cruise, and the M Sport package sharpens the looks without costing ride quality. Complete service records are available for inspection and the cabin shows almost no wear.

Long bonnet, hand-built V8 and a soundtrack that never gets old. This low-mileage AMG GT S has been garaged and driven sparingly, and it comes with its full set of Mercedes-Benz service documents. A rare chance to own a genuine everyday-usable supercar at a sensible point on the depreciation curve.

The A7 Sportback is one of the best-looking cars in its class and this Glacier White example shows why. The 3.0-litre V6 with quattro grip is smooth, fast and deeply comfortable over long distances. Cabin condition is excellent, with a fully working MMI touch system and no warning lights.

The benchmark sports car, in the colour that suits it best. This 992-generation Carrera S has covered under 9,000 km, is fitted with the Sport Chrono package and has been maintained strictly by the book. Every drive is an event, yet it is docile enough for daily use.

Quiet, spacious and remarkably frugal, the Camry Hybrid is the sensible executive sedan with a luxury feel. This one-owner example has been used mostly for highway commutes and returns excellent real-world efficiency. Toyota reliability with almost nothing to do but drive.

Coupe styling, SUV presence and a torque-rich six-cylinder diesel. The GLE Coupe 400d cruises effortlessly and has the road manners of a much lower car. Fully loaded with air suspension, the MBUX system and a full Burmester sound setup, and it has never been used commercially.

A sharp, well-equipped A4 with quattro all-wheel drive and a strong turbocharged engine. The S line package gives it a purposeful stance, and inside you get the virtual cockpit and a crisp Bang & Olufsen-style audio upgrade. Serviced on schedule at an authorised Audi centre.

A frozen-grey 430i coupe that looks the part and drives even better. Rear-wheel drive balance, a punchy turbo four and a beautifully judged M Sport chassis make it engaging on a favourite road and easy in traffic. Clean history and a tidy, unmodified example.

Commanding, capable and beautifully finished. This Range Rover Sport HSE in Santorini Black has air suspension, a Meridian sound system and the full terrain-response system. Two careful owners, extensive service history, and a cabin that has aged gracefully.

The turbo-DCT Verna is the enthusiast's choice in the segment, quick off the line and a great highway companion. A one-owner car with well-documented servicing, a spotless interior and all keys and manuals present.

Roomy, refined and easy to live with, the City ZX CVT is the top-spec variant with a sunroof and lane-watch camera. Smooth CVT, excellent fuel economy and Honda's legendary reliability. Serviced at authorised Honda workshops.

A feature-rich compact SUV with a torquey diesel and a slick six-speed automatic. This GTX+ has the Bose audio system, ventilated seats and a panoramic sunroof, and was mostly driven on highways. Bodywork and interior are in very good condition.

All the practicality of a family estate with the performance of a supercar. This RS6 Avant in Nardo Grey has carbon ceramic brakes, the dynamic package and a lightly used, mostly highway history. Its 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 is as smooth as it is savage.

The top AX7 L with ADAS, panoramic sunroof and 7-seat layout. This example is powered by the strong 2.2-litre diesel with a smooth six-speed automatic, making it equally at home with a family on a road trip or in the city. Mostly used by a single owner.

An almost-new Nexon EV Max with a real-world range that comfortably covers a week of city commuting. The battery health report is clean, the fast-charging port works flawlessly and the car comes with its portable charger. Perfect for a first EV.

features.name: Connected EV app with charge scheduling

description: The flagship in long-wheelbase form: a serene, chauffeur-friendly cabin with the substance to reward the driver. This 730Ld has executive-lounge rear seats, a Bowers & Wilkins system and seamless diesel refinement. Maintained by BMW and never used for hire.

One of the prettiest cars of its generation, in Firenze Red. The 2.0-litre turbo is quick and economical, and the R-Dynamic chassis is playful without being unruly. Low mileage, single owner, full service history at Jaguar Land Rover.

The all-weather AMG: a biturbo V6, 4MATIC traction and a cabin fit for a much larger car. This C 43 has the night package and a well-maintained mechanical history. It is fast, discreet and everyday usable.

Honda's practical, spacious SUV with a fuss-free diesel and all-wheel drive. With two owners, complete service records and honest, well-kept interiors, this CR-V is a great pick for family duty or long-distance touring.

A naturally aspirated V10 that revs to 8,700 rpm — a sound that will never come again. This Tango Red R8 V10 Plus is one-owner, garage kept and comes with full documentation. Exotic drama with Audi usability.

A four-door with a proper sports-car soul. The Panamera 4 combines a hushed, lavish cabin with the handling that only Porsche gets right. Fitted with air suspension and the Sport Chrono package, in immaculate condition inside and out.

The warm hatch of the i20 range with a sharp turbo three-cylinder and sportier suspension. A well-loved, low-mileage example with the N Line body kit, Bose sound and all service records. Fun, frugal and full of character.

The M2 Competition is a compact, tactile, rear-wheel-drive rocket in Long Beach Blue. Its twin-turbo straight-six punches hard and the chassis communicates beautifully. A single-owner car with a spotless history and no track use.

American muscle with the burble to prove it. A naturally aspirated 5.0-litre V8, launch control and a well-judged chassis make this GT a joy at any speed. Shadow Black, single owner, low mileage and a clean interior.
The Polo GT TSI is a solid, well-built hatchback with an eager turbo engine and a 7-speed DSG. Genuinely fun in traffic and refined on the highway. One owner, always serviced on time.

A tall-boy hatchback that is effortless to drive and cheap to run. The top Asta trim brings touchscreen infotainment, a reverse camera and rear AC vents. Perfect as a first car or a city runabout, with light usage and a tidy cabin.
